roleInfo.name: Mafia
roleInfo.description: You are Mafia. You can Check, Buff, Vote, and Shoot. Eliminate all Townspeople.

roleInfo.name: Townsperson
roleInfo.description: You are a Townsperson. You can Check, Buff, and Vote. Eliminate all Mafia.

Default.actionPollQuestion: What will you do this turn? (or wait)
Default.whoNeedsTutorialQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.tutOverviewText: You are secretly Mafia or a Townsperson. Everyone starts with 10 HP, shown as your score — only YOU can see your own HP. Mafia win when every Townsperson is eliminated; Town wins when every Mafia is eliminated. You are eliminated when your HP hits 0.
Default.tutTurnsText: There are no day or night phases. Every few seconds everyone simultaneously chooses one action (or waits). If you pick an action, you then pick a target.
Default.tutActionsText:
Check (−5 HP): privately learn a player's alignment.
Buff (−1 HP): give another player +2 HP.
Vote (−1 HP): deplete another player by 2 HP — this one is public.
Shoot (Mafia only, free): deplete another player by 4 HP.
Default.tutCooldownText: Each action has a cooldown, counted in turns, before you can use it again: Vote 3, Buff 9, Shoot 15, Check 25. You can never spend HP you don't have — an action you can't afford is hidden.
Default.tutNoActionText: If you don't choose an action in time, you simply wait. If you choose an action but no target, a random valid target is picked for you.
